title: JMAP Tasks revived: updated draft by Mark + crate implementation of his 17 items
description: Mark 2026-11-13: the WG was wrong to drop JMAP Tasks. (a) Mark writes an updated Tasks draft folding in his 17 jmapio/jmap items (#456-#472), JMAP Data Types registrations with Supports History, Calendars -34 alignment. (b) The tasks crates (jmap-tasks-types/-server/-client, jmap-chat-tasks-server) implement those items now as the de facto reference. No WG approach for now. Decision: docs/design/DECISIONS.md #23. Spec base: /data/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06.txt; editor's source /data/GIT/jmapio-jmap spec/tasks/*.mdown; Mark's item on github.com/jmapio/jmap (gh issue view/pr view <n> -R jmapio/jmap). Prior crate audit: JMAP-t8ej.17.
